1.6.rationale: The original Indonesian text explicitly addresses a harmful practice: child/early marriage. Pasal 8 ayat (1) states families/parents are obligated to prevent early-age marriage ("mencegah terjadinya perkawinan pada usia dini"). Pasal 14 ayat (1) also includes awareness-raising on "pernikahan usia Anak" and a "Program Pendewasaan usia perkawinan". Since the policy clearly includes harmful practices (child marriage) within its prevention/obligations framework, a 'Yes' assessment is supported; the golden label 'No' appears incorrect.
